as_told.title: Jake Barber as helicopter delivery pilot in retrievals

plain: In 2025, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a commentator named Matthew Pines spoke about a man named Jake Barber. Barber describes having worked in a crash retrieval program, a secret effort said to recover crashed craft that are not of human making. Pines says he finds Barber extremely credible and truthful, but sees him as essentially a delivery man, a helicopter pilot who knows what he saw without knowing the whole picture. If Pines is right, Barber's account would be a real first-hand glimpse of such a program, though only from the edges.
